Formula Exponential-decay variant, opportunity-rows orientation: for every column node j the kernel sums rows i in ascending order and adds weight[i] * exp(-beta * cost[i,j]) for finite costs 0 <= cost <= threshold and finite weights (unreached +Infinity entries and non-finite weights are skipped; the sum is deterministic, no float atomics, and weights are not normalised). The cumulative variant omits the decay and the power variant uses max(cost, minimumCost)^-beta; they are alternative branches of the same kernel.
